summary: Query zillow.com (US real-estate portal) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the zillow-mcp server — search listings, pull a full property record by zpid, price/tax/Zestimate history, photos, market reports, and your signed-in saved searches/homes, all via one-shot HTTP calls through a signed-in browser tab. Use when you want Zillow data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.
